SELECT s.stamp_id AS stampId, c.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, r.name AS regionName, si.name AS siteName, s.mission_verified_at AS completedAt, s.user_sentence AS userSentence,
CASE WHEN ph.has_other_face = 1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(s.photo_key, ph.file_key) END AS photoKey, s.ext_manuscript_id AS extManuscriptId, m.title AS extTitle, m.body AS extBody FROM stamp s JOIN pilgrimage p ON p.pilgrimage_id = s.pilgrimage_id JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = c.region_id LEFT JOIN site si ON si.site_id = s.site_id LEFT JOIN manuscript m ON m.manuscript_id = s.ext_manuscript_id LEFT JOIN photo ph ON ph.user_id = p.user_id AND ph.site_id = s.site_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND s.verify_status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY s.mission_verified_at, s.stamp_id

SELECT ph.photo_id AS photoId, si.name AS siteName, ph.file_key AS fileKey, ph.created_at AS createdAt FROM photo ph LEFT JOIN site si ON si.site_id = ph.site_id WHERE ph.user_id = #{userId} AND ph.has_other_face = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stamp s JOIN pilgrimage p ON p.pilgrimage_id = s.pilgrimage_id WHERE p.user_id = ph.user_id AND s.site_id = ph.site_id AND s.verify_status = 'COMPLETED') ORDER BY ph.created_at, ph.photo_id

SELECT t.thinkbox_id AS thinkboxId, si.name AS siteName, t.body AS content, t.is_private AS isPrivate, t.is_edited AS edited, t.created_at AS createdAt FROM thinkbox t LEFT JOIN site si ON si.site_id = t.site_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.created_at, t.thinkbox_id

SELECT ct.serial_no AS serialNo, ct.cert_type AS certType, c.name AS courseName, ct.issued_at AS issuedAt FROM certificate ct LEFT JOIN pilgrimage p ON p.pilgrimage_id = ct.pilgrimage_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id WHERE ct.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.status = 'VALID' ORDER BY ct.issued_at, ct.certificate_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pilgrimage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meditation_log WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(played_sec), 0) FROM meditation_log WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT nickname FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
